critical.issue: CORS preflight (OPTIONS) fails from origin https://react-app-staging-2.preview.emergentagent.com — no Access-Control-Allow-Origin (or non-2xx status). This blocks the booking-rate-grid from populating cells and therefore blocks the entire New Booking flow on Front Desk (Beta) when accessed via the staging origin.

integration_issues.issue: booking-rate-grid mounts but never receives room-availability data because that upstream call is blocked by CORS; UI shows an empty grid with no `booking-cell-*` nodes, so users cannot select a suite/room. Suggest either (a) fix CORS on room-availability at the API gateway, (b) proxy through the staging frontend origin, or (c) display an inline error state on the empty grid so QA/users see the failure instead of a silent empty grid.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: preprod.mygenie.online/api/v2/vendoremployee/aiosell/room-availability rejects CORS preflight (OPTIONS) from origin https://react-app-staging-2.preview.emergentagent.com — either missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin for this origin or preflight response returns a non-2xx status. Browser cancels the actual request, so the Front Desk (Beta) NewBookingForm never receives inventory to render `booking-cell-*` cells. Reproduction: login as QA_TGK -> /pms/front-desk-v2 -> Arrivals tab -> New Booking -> fill name/phone/dates/adults -> DevTools Network shows OPTIONS /aiosell/room-availability blocked by CORS and console shows 'blocked by CORS policy'. Mitigation: add the staging origin to the CORS allow-list for /aiosell/room-availability on preprod, or route the call through the frontend origin (same-origin proxy). fetch-rates and fetch-inventory (which the same page calls) already work from this origin, so this is a per-endpoint configuration gap.
